_about: Parts of the drawing that have stages (web/js/barge_buildings.js, stage). building: the level without the prefix that makes the part; ink: its layer in data/crew_ui_art.json; pencil, build: layers of web/art/layers.json (tools/web_art.py); turns_at: where the turns left are written while it is built, in units of the drawing (1040 x 760).
